scene: You step off the rickshaw into bustling Paper Lantern Row.
picture: Flat pixel-art side view along a brick street. On the far left, a vendor tends a steaming bamboo basket. Left of centre sits an empty two-wheeled rickshaw. In the centre, an elderly East Asian man in a blue cap, orange cardigan, and wooden cane looks up at an orange goldfish kite hanging up high. On the far right, a glowing lantern workshop doorway stands open.
shown: a steaming bamboo basket on a wooden cart on the far left
a large orange paper goldfish kite hanging up high above you
an open curtained doorway glowing with yellow light on the far right
